Regions dataset

Source: R/datasets.R
data_regions.Rd

Data frame containing the names and codes of geographic regions used in the MRC projection models. Each row defines one region to which countries can be assigned.

  • Name. Full name of the region (character)

  • Region. Short region code used internally as an identifier (character)

Format

Data frame with 6 rows and 2 variables

See also

Other base_data: base_data_list, data_asfr, data_births_ratio, data_fertility_differentials, data_migration_destination, data_migration_rates, data_population, data_structure, data_survivability, data_switching, info_variants

Examples

head(base_data_list[[11]])
#> # A tibble: 6 × 2
#>   Name                     Region
#>   <chr>                    <chr> 
#> 1 Europe                   EURO  
#> 2 Middle East North Africa MENA  
#> 3 Sub-Saharan Africa       SSAF  
#> 4 Asia Pacific             ASPA  
#> 5 Latin America Caribbean  LACA  
#> 6 North America            NOAM
